notes: B-57 control (2026-10-29), twin of jeskai_elder_blocked.json: 'Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a PLAYER, you may draw a card. If you do, discard a card.' Unblocked, the Elder deals 1 combat damage to the opponent, so the trigger fires: draw the top filler card (hand 1 -> 2), then discard one (hand back to 1, one card in the graveyard). The recipient filter is now 'not a permanent' (= a player, CR 120.1), and this pack pins that it still matches the player.
